prompt:
Our community mental health intake coordinator has left three raw client questionnaire records in intake_system/pending_review/ (files: intake_2025_001_raw.json, intake_2025_002_raw.json, intake_2025_003_raw.json). Each file contains the client's responses to several psychological questionnaires collected during their initial contact.

For each of the three cases, please process the raw responses, compute the appropriate assessment scores, determine the correct clinical risk classification, and generate a structured triage report file named triage_report_{case_id}.json (e.g., triage_report_2025-INT-001.json). The reports will be used by clinical staff to prioritize scheduling and determine the appropriate level of care.

Make sure the reports are complete and actionable — the clinical team needs to know exactly what to do next for each client, including any emergency protocols, specific support resources, or referral recommendations that apply to their situation.
